jobs.title: Software Designer (C#, C++, Java)
jobs.description:
As a Software Designer C#/C++/JAVA, you develop software for high-tech products and machines.

In this role, you support our customers in the semiconductor, analytical instrumentation, and medical equipment industries, within the triangle of Nijmegen, Enschede, and Zwolle, by delivering smart, sustainable, and reliable software solutions. Your software expertise plays an essential role in bringing these high-tech solutions to life.

What excites you as a Software Designer (C#, C++, Java)?

As a Software Designer, you contribute to defining requirements and you are responsible for translating them into robust software designs, ensuring high-quality implementation and seamless integration. You are eager to grow into a role where you bring your own technical contribution, while guiding the development team.

From our office in Mijdrecht and at our clients' premises you work on challenging projects that take technology to the next level. You are the expert who designs, develops, and tests, but also likes to think along, connect, and contribute to team results, and who likes to:

Translating customer and system requirements into innovative, clear, and feasible concepts during the conceptual phase of projects.
Acting as a bridge between architects and engineers from a technical perspective.
Taking responsibility for a module/subsystem throughout the entire software development lifecycle.
Ensuring software quality, scalability and maintainability through sound engineering practices.
Applying strong communication skills to effectively guide and mentor a team of engineers, helping them grow and deliver high-quality results.

Sounds good? We’d love to tell you more…

Your future workplace

This is what you bring to the table

You have a technical Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Computer Engineering.
You have 7+ years of experience in technical software development, gained in various roles and across diverse product environments and/or projects.
Over the past 4–5 years, you have worked within technical domains such as Semicon, Medical, or Analytical.
You have experience with at least two of the following programming languages: C#, C++, or Java.
You have knowledge of and/or experience with various development methodologies and techniques such as Design Patterns, UML, and Agile, and you keep your technical expertise up to date. You are looking for an environment where you can apply these developments in practice as well.
Based on your experience, you are able to coach junior engineers.
You are a team player and keep the common goal in mind.
You have a good command of both Dutch and English, spoken and written.
You hold a valid European driver’s license and are willing to travel.

This is what you can expect in return from Sioux

Flexible 32-40 hour working week, with room to work from home.
A healthy work-life balance is very important to us. We have 28 holidays with an option to acquire an additional 12 holidays.
You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success.
By combining our expertise in software, electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, mathematics and assembly, we make the impossible possible for our customers and get to work on challenging high-tech projects.
You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing.
Personal coaching and a training budget of €6000 per year, so that you can continue to develop yourself.
We also find it important to have fun together. We organize a lot for our employees, from events together with your partner and family, summer barbecues, innovative knowledge sessions to tasty lunches and after work drinks.
You will be working at a prime location in a green, wooded environment, close to the Veluwe National Park. The perfect base within the triangle of Enschede, Zwolle, and Nijmegen.

High Tech & High Fun

We can tell you all about the typical Sioux-culture and the high-tech challenging projects. About how you can develop yourself, like nowhere else. But we’d rather have you hear it from our own employees.

Go to testimonials >

If you want to know more about our challenging projects, please click here.

This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the US Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R.

730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require Sioux to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.

jobs.title: developer
jobs.description:
Wil jij jouw skills en ervaring graag maatschappelijk inzetten? Ben jij een developer die geen uitdaging uit de weg gaat? Solliciteer dan nu!

Wat ga je doen?

Jij vertaalt de userstory’s en bedenkt samen met je team oplossingen en manieren om een toegewezen applicatie op technisch en op functioneel gebied te verbeteren. Dit doe je samen met je collega’s in een multidisciplinair scrumteam. Als lid van een multidisciplinair team ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor

Front- en/of backend ontwerpen, beheren en door ontwikkelen van onze registratieve systemen;
Het ontwikkelen en aanbrengen van wijzigingen in de database;
Het (door)ontwikkelen van het Continuous Integration en het Continuous Delivery proces (o.a. Jenkins);
In sprints waarde voor de business ontwikkelen en opleveren;
Meedraaien in piketrooster voor beheer en implementatie.

Meer over DevOps bij de politie.

Waar ga je werken?

Binnen het productiehuis bouwen en onderhouden zo’n honderd DevOps-teams de informatiesystemen voor de Nederlandse politie. Jij gaat werken binnen de Hanze Express van Productielijn Handhaving.

Binnen de productielijn staat het delen van kennis en ervaring centraal. Onze hoofdtaak is het bouwen, onderhouden en beheren van een webapplicatie en de daaronder liggende middleware en ondersteunende systemen (API’s). We werken volgens de Agile-methodiek met prioritering vanaf de product backlog. De teams combineren het thuiswerken deels met werken op het politiedienstencentrum te Zwolle. Onze teams werken onder andere aan

De Basis Voorziening Handhaving (BVH) is de applicatie die door de basispolitiezorg wordt gebruikt om proces-verbaal op te maken van incidenten, aanhoudingen, verhoren, verkeersongevallen, inbeslaggenomen goederen en dergelijke.
De Generieke Gegevens Koppeling (GGK) is een platform dat de uitwisseling van gegevens uit de verschillende BVH's binnen de politie efficiënt en veilig mogelijk maakt door gebruik te maken van RESTful API’s en Event Driven Architecture-oplossingen, met een focus op standaardisatie van gegevens en interoperabiliteit tussen systemen.
De Handhaving Ontsluiting Service (HOS) ontsluit gegevens uit registratieve systemen binnen de BVH naar andere diensten binnen de politie.

Om meer inzicht te krijgen hoe onze systemen bijdragen aan de politietaak stimuleren we onze medewerkers om dit zelf te ervaren door een dienst mee te gaan met een collega in het veld.

Wie ben jij?

Jij kunt binnen een complexe omgeving slimme IT-aanpassingen te bedenken en realiseren. Feedback geven en krijgen gaat je goed af en je maakt je nieuwe kennis snel eigen. Je bent gericht op samenwerken en neemt het voortouw om het team met elkaar te laten afstemmen. Je gaat uitdagingen niet uit de weg en je denkt graag mee aan vernieuwende oplossingen. Je hebt de kennis en ook ruime ervaring om de continuïteit en kwaliteit van softwareontwikkeling te kunnen borgen. Je bent je bewust van je vaardigheden en werkt actief aan het vergroten van je expertise. Verder heb je

HBO (bachelor) werk- en denkniveau*, bij voorkeur op basis van een IT-opleiding;
3 jaar ervaring in de talen JAVA, Angular en SQL
Ervaring met unittesten en bij voorkeur met testautomatisering (wij gebruiken Selenium en Cucumber) en de beveiligingsaspecten van software.
Bij voorkeur werkervaring in CI/CD-Pipelines (wij werken met Jenkins, ArgoCD en XL Deploy) en met een Agile werkwijze, zoals Scrum
Kennis van systemen zoalsOpenShift (Podman, Docker) en Weblogic.
Werkervaring met versiebeheer zoals bijv. GIT.
Ervaring met Linux
Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift.

Wat wij bieden

De standplaats is Zwolle. Er is ruimte voor 2 fte. Het betreft een functie voor 36 uur per week.

Omdat goede mensen belangrijk zijn binnen de politie investeren we in jouw toekomst. We bieden uitgebreide ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en een aanstelling in tijdelijke dienst voor een proeftijd van een jaar. Bij voldoende functioneren zetten we na een jaar de aanstelling o m in een vaste aanstelling. Verder kun je van ons verwachten

een bruto maandsalaris van minimaal € 3.734,- en maximaal € 5.882,- (schaal 10 Bbp) op basis van een 36-urige werkweek;
een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) dat uit twee delen bestaat
Een bruto deel van 17,86% van je salaris. Met dit budget kun je een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samenstellen. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het uitbetalen van je budget, het kopen van vakantie-uren of ontwikkelactiviteiten zoals een opleiding.
Een netto deel van € 515,91 per jaar. Dit budget kun je bijvoorbeeld gebruiken voor duurzaamheidsdoelen, vakbondscontributie en voor vitaliteit.

een uitstekende pensioenopbouw bij ABP en betaald ouderschapsverlof ( meer info over verlof, regelingen en mogelijkheden ).

De formele functie binnen het functiegebouw van de politie is bedrijfsvoeringspecialist B.

Interesse?

Als je meer informatie over de functie wilt hebben of voor vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure bel of mail met Matthijs Reinhard, recruiter (06 - 39 01 43 75, Matthijs.Reinhard@politie.nl ).

Solliciteer uiterlijk 18 oktober 2026 via de sollicitatiebutton.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

Wat verder belangrijk is

Een betrouwbaarheids- en omgevingsonderzoek maakt deel uit van de selectieprocedure.
Goed politiewerk heeft verschillende inzichten nodig. Met welke unieke blik kom jij ons versterken?
Je hebt een diploma op hbo (bachelor)-niveau of je bent daaraan gelijkgesteld via EVC. Of je hebt minimaal twee jaar werkervaring op het gevraagde niveau. Dit toon je aan met een erkende functieomschrijving of een formeel vastgestelde vacaturetekst of een ander formeel bewijsstuk. Het bewijsstuk heeft aantoonbaar betrekking op een functie die je daadwerkelijk hebt uitgevoerd en moet herleidbaar zijn tot jouw persoon. Denk aan een werkgeversverklaring waarin het werk- en denkniveau staat opgenomen of een uittreksel uit het HR-systeem waarop je functie en het dienstverband zichtbaar zijn.

Full-time

Law Enforcement, Public Safety, and Security and Investigations

jobs.title: AI Platform engineer
jobs.description:
Your job

Within WUR, we are setting up our own chatAI environment in which our users (students, teachers, researchers) can use the possibilities of Artificial Intelligence for research and education safely and within established guardrails. This includes the WUR AI Chat, the WUR LLM Hub and integrations with internal data sources.

As an AI Platform Engineer, you will be part of an ambitious and technically strong team that is responsible for developing and maintaining our WUR AI Facility. You play a key role in setting up and managing the necessary infrastructure in Azure, provisioning of the CI/CD pipeline, monitoring and improving performance and improving the user experience. The system management covers infrastructure, platform, applications and functional services.

We are looking for someone with a passion for IT, who has experience in building reliable infrastructure solutions based on Azure cloud solutions and on-premise cloud-native container environments.

Your tasks and responsibilities as an AI Platform Engineer are:

provisioning, managing, and further developing secure, reliable, and scalable Azure and Kubernetes environment(s) for the AI Facility;
provision and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes, including rollback and release procedures;
manage environments, infrastructure resources, technical configurations, and dependencies, while ensuring version control and consistent provisioning across all environments;
documenting technical architecture, management procedures and runbooks;
automate the use and management. Supporting releases and analyzing technical incidents, malfunctions and performance issues;
monitoring and improving platform performance, security, manageability and reliability. Setting up and maintaining the necessary monitoring, alerting and observability;
collaborate with software developers to improve the user experience;
you build it, you own it: you solve disruptions and performance issues together with your colleagues.

Your team

You will work in a team with a product owner, a scrum master, a solution architect, software developers and IT engineers. Our IT teams work according to agile principles. Collaboration, communication, transparency and continuous feedback are essential. You will work on campus at least two days a week and can choose to work partly from home as well, for good focus and a healthy work-life balance.

You will work here

You will work in a professional IT organization with more than 200 IT specialists where you can learn a lot and develop yourself well. We have two of our own data centers on our beautiful, green and spacious campus and we are committed to digital sovereignty, the use of open source solutions and a sustainable use of our environment. You will work with state-of-the-art technology in the field of Artificial Intelligence and the infrastructure used for this.

Your qualities

You are an independent and inquisitive IT professional with a DevOps mindset. You like to work together with other professionals and different stakeholders in an agile environment. You are a connector and dare to speak out and ask questions. You are a real go-getter, have strong communication skills and have a warm heart for education and research. In addition, you are analytically minded but also solution- and customer-oriented. You are enterprising and have the drive and organizational talent to get things done as a driving force. You are creative and always look for new solutions to make existing environments more effective and new functionalities possible. You also have a good eye for the availability, stability, scalability and user-friendliness of the infrastructure provided.

You Also Possess

HBO working and thinking level, preferably through a completed HBO ICT education;
experience as a System Administrator or DevOps Engineer in an enterprise environment;
knowledge of and experience with Linux and Kubernetes environments and Azure cloud solutions;
knowledge of designing and managing cloud-native concepts;
experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform, Ansible) and a declarative mindset;
experience with containerization and CI/CD tools (e.g. ArgoCD, Git(lab));
basic knowledge of programming and scripting languages such as Python or Bash;
a good command of Dutch and English. The working language within the IT organization is Dutch, but in our international working environment, more and more communication is in English.

You can see that there are plenty of challenges for you. These challenges can also be seen as development opportunities. So if you do not yet have the track record required in the vacancy, but do have solid work experience, we would also like to invite you to apply.

We offer

Wageningen University & Research offers excellent terms of employment (https://www.wur.nl/en/jobs/conditions-of-employment). A few highlights from our Collective Labour Agreement include:

working hours that can be discussed and arranged so that they allow for the best possible work-life balance;
sabbatical leave, study leave, and partially paid parental leave;
there is a strong focus on vitality and you can make use of the sports facilities available on campus for a small fee;
a fixed year-end bonus of 8,3%;
excellent pension scheme.

Of course, these excellent fringe benefits also include an appropriate salary. Depending on your experience, we offer a salary of a minimum of € 3,554.- to a maximum of € 6,471.- for a full working week of 36 hours according to Collective Labor Agreement Wageningen Research (scale 10/11). For this role, an appointment of 32 hours is also negotiable. We initially offer a one-year contract, with the intention of converting it to an indefinite contract

We encourage development and internal mobility within our organisation. Our recruitment and selection policy sets out the conditions that apply specifically to you as a (former) employee. If you have any questions, we are happy to help.

You will work on the greenest and most innovative campus in the Netherlands, in an international and open working atmosphere.

If you are an internal employee, your current contract is the starting point. Ask your HR Business Partner about your situation specifically.

Coming from abroad

Wageningen University & Research is the university and research centre for life sciences. The themes we deal with are relevant to everyone around the world and Wageningen, therefore, has a large international community and a lot to offer to international employees.

Because we expect you to work and live in the Netherlands our team of advisors on Dutch immigration procedures will help you with the visa application procedures for yourself and, if applicable, for your family. If you come with a partner, we offer a Dual Career group program organized by our Welcome Center (https://wcfv.nl/en/home/global/our-services/happy-landing-and-living/). This program helps your partner to get familiar with the Dutch culture, labour market and assists your partner to find a job.

Feeling welcome also has everything to do with being well informed. Wageningen University & Research's International Community (https://www.wur.nl/en/jobs/expats-new-international-staff) page contains practical information about what we can do to support international employees coming to Wageningen. Furthermore, our Welcome Center can assist you with any additional advice and information about for example housing, opening a bank account or schooling. Finally, certain categories of international staff may be eligible for a tax exemption on a part of their salary during the first five years in the Netherlands.

Important information

For more information about the position, please contact Roy Bartels (Department Manager) via email: roy.bartels@wur.nl (mailto:roy.bartels@wur.nl).

Questions about the procedure? Please contact Edvard Jongschaap, Sr Corporate Recruiter, via email: edvard.jongschaap@wur.nl (mailto:edvard.jongschaap@wur.nl) or by phone: +31 371 – 489 178.

Ready to apply?

Click on the application button for the vacancy on our website. Only applications via our website will be processed.

You can respond until Monday, November 2, 2026
. The first interviews are scheduled for Thursday, November 5, 2026. Preferably, internal candidates apply before October 2, 2026.

Applications are reviewed regularly. It is therefore possible that the vacancy has been filled earlier than the stated closing date.

Screening policy
.

Submitting a valid Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) and requesting references are part of the application procedure.

Procedure

Within our selection procedure, an assessment of working and thinking level can be included as part of the process.

Welcome, safe, and valued

Wageningen University & Research (WUR) highly values diversity and inclusion because we believe that different insights lead to innovative solutions. We create a work environment where everyone feels welcome, safe, and appreciated, regardless of background, identity, or experience. Together, we are building a culture where everyone's unique contribution adds to the success of our organization.

We are

The mission of Wageningen University & Research is “To explore the potential of nature to improve the quality of life”. Under the banner Wageningen University & Research, Wageningen University and the specialised research institutes of the Wageningen Research Foundation have joined forces in contributing to finding solutions to important questions in the domain of healthy food and living environment. With its roughly 30 branches, 7,600 employees (6,700 fte) and 13,100 students and over 150,000 participants to WUR’s Life Long Learning, Wageningen University & Research is one of the leading organisations in its domain. The unique Wageningen approach lies in its integrated approach to issues and the collaboration between different disciplines.

Read the 5 reasons (https://www.wur.nl/en/Jobs/Why-choose-WUR.htm) why your future colleagues enjoy working at WUR and watch the video below to get an idea of our green campus!

We will recruit for the vacancy ourselves, so no employment agencies please. However, sharing in your network is appreciated.
